"A" Fort and Battery Hill Redoubt-Camp Early
, also known as Measles Fort, is a historic
American Civil War
military facility and
redoubt
located in
Fairfax County, Virginia
south of
Centreville
and along
Bull Run
.
It was listed on the
National Register of Historic Places
in 1998.
